name: Dragon Scales
text: Overlapping scales pried from a dragon’s hide, still faintly warm or cold to the touch depending on its kind. Prized by armorers and by enchanters working protective magic.

name: Vial of Dragon Blood
text: Thick blood drawn from a dragon and stoppered quickly. Alchemists use it in potions of strength and resistance.

name: Dragon Teeth
text: Fangs the length of a dagger. Carved into charms, set into weapons, or ground for reagents.

name: Vampire Fang
text: A long canine taken from a destroyed vampire. A sought-after component for necromancy and blood magic.

name: Basilisk Eye
text: A dull, heavy eye that has turned partly to stone. Used in transmutation and in reagents against petrification.

name: Unicorn Hair
text: A shining strand from a unicorn’s mane. Rare and potent in healing and protective magic. Taking it from a slain unicorn is a grave act in most lands.

name: Unicorn Horn Shavings
text: Fine curls shaved from a unicorn’s horn, kept in a sealed vial. Legendary as a cure for poison and disease.

name: Gorgon Blood
text: Metallic, grey-green blood that hardens in the air. Alchemists use it in stoneskin draughts.

name: Manticore Spines
text: Barbed tail spikes, still sharp enough to cut. Used as darts, arrowheads, or a reagent for poisons.

name: Lich Dust
text: A handful of grey ash from a destroyed lich, cold to the touch. Necromancers pay well for it, and most temples want it destroyed.

name: Bat Wings
text: Dried leathery wings. A common component for flight and darkvision magic.

name: Chimera Scales
text: Mismatched scales from a chimera’s hide, each a different color. Used in transmutation and polymorph magic.

name: Djinni’s Tear
text: A single drop of glowing water caught in a crystal bead. Used in powerful air and wish-related magic.

name: Ectoplasm
text: Glistening, faintly glowing residue left where a ghost was destroyed. Kept in a stoppered jar; used in spells that touch the Ethereal Plane.

name: Spectral Dust
text: Grey, weightless dust that drifts upward when the jar is opened. Used in necromancy and in wards against the undead.

name: Celestial Feather
text: A feather that gives off a soft light. Used in radiant and healing magic, and as an offering in temples.

name: Giant’s Toenail
text: A toenail the size of a shield, thick as horn. Ground into powder for strength potions.

name: Will-o’-Wisp Essence
text: The last flicker of a destroyed will-o’-wisp, trapped in a corked bottle. Used in light and illusion magic.

name: Owlbear Feathers
text: Coarse brown feathers, half fur at the root. Fletchers like them, and they make fine trophies.

name: Troll Blood
text: Dark green blood that keeps trying to clot into flesh. The key reagent in potions of regeneration.

name: Hydra Tooth
text: A curved tooth from one of a hydra’s heads. Used in growth and regeneration reagents.

name: Cockatrice Feather
text: A stiff grey feather that feels like cold stone. Used in petrification magic and its cures.

name: Hell Hound Ember Gland
text: The gland behind a hell hound’s throat that fuels its fiery breath, still smoldering. Used in fire magic and alchemist’s fire.

name: Medusa’s Petrified Snakes
text: Snakes from a medusa’s head that turned to stone when she died. Used in petrification magic and its cures.

name: Phase Spider Silk
text: A spool of silk that flickers in and out of sight. Weavers and enchanters use it for ethereal and teleportation magic.

name: Griffon Feather
text: A broad golden-brown flight feather. Used for flight magic and prized by fletchers.

name: Harpy Feather
text: A greasy, foul-smelling feather. Bards say it is used in charm magic; most people just say it stinks.

name: Wyvern Stinger
text: The venomous tail barb of a wyvern, with its venom sac still attached. A potent poison reagent; handle with care.

name: Rust Monster Antenna
text: A feathery antenna that still corrodes metal it touches. Smiths and alchemists use it to dissolve locks and chains.

name: Mimic Adhesive
text: A jar of the sticky substance a mimic uses to hold its prey. Bonds almost anything together.

name: Treant Heartwood
text: A piece of living wood from the heart of a treant. Druids use it for staffs and powerful nature magic, and few will forgive whoever took it.

name: Salamander Scale
text: A scale that stays hot enough to light tinder. Used in fire magic and fire-resistant gear.
